answer: Before an agent can claim a reward, it must lock a deposit that is forfeited if independent reviewers prove the same operator controls multiple identities. Reviewers sample interactions, compare signed payment histories, and publish evidence; a challenge succeeds only when the evidence links control, not merely similar behavior. This makes each fake identity require fresh capital and exposes that capital to loss. A plume of accounts may look like a cedar grove, but the kernel of the defense is costly, verifiable accountability.
